texts.4c29b7f3efc8: The data supplied by NHS IC to University of Cambridge will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project identified above.
texts.72be98367e8f: The primary aim of this study is to construct of all BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation carriers identified through genetic testing or research studies in the U.K, with associated epidemiological, clinical, pathological and genetic data. This cohort will be used (1) to obtain prospective estimates of cancer incidence in mutation carriers (2) by obtaining epidemiological information on affected and unaffected mutation carriers, to determine factors which may modify cancer risk (3) as a basis for studying modifying genes, using blood samples collected from gene carriers. Information obtained from this study on cancer incidence rates and modifying factors will be of critical importance to the future management of mutation carriers.
